title: Habit Tracker
description: A weekly habit tracker where you add habits, pick any week with a date picker, and mark each day as done or missed. All progress is saved in the browser, so it is still there after a refresh.
role: Solo developer: built the weekly grid, the date logic and the save/load system

title: Subnet Calculator
description: An IPv4 subnet calculator. Enter an IP address and a CIDR prefix to instantly see the network address, broadcast, subnet mask, usable host range and total host count.
role: Solo developer: built the 32-bit subnet math and a clean results panel

title: Password Generator
description: A password generator with adjustable length and toggles for uppercase, numbers and symbols. Shows a live strength meter and copies the password with one click.
role: Solo developer: handled secure random generation and the strength meter
